item.title: Lead Rust Engineer
item.description:
Own your future

Our culture isn’t something people join, it’s something they build and shape. We believe that every person deserves to be heard and empowered. If you’re on the fence about whether you’re a fit, we say go for it. Let’s build something great together.

 

We are hiring a Lead Rust Engineer to own the technical direction and build the service and API layer of a next-generation data platform for one of our clients. The immediate work is backend services and APIs, including moving existing client integrations onto a new API surface and building out a Rust service layer.

 

The new services we are building are in Rust, with some C# in the mix, while parts of the current platform still run on Ruby. We need a hands-on technical leader who is comfortable across that landscape and picks up new pieces quickly.

‍

Key responsibilities

  • Set technical direction, priorities and engineering standards.
  • Own architecture and API design decisions for the new service layer and the migration path from legacy systems.
  • Design, build and maintain backend services and APIs, with Rust as the primary language.
  • Develop and extend the Rust service layer that sits at the core of the new platform.
  • Migrate existing clients, written in C# and Ruby, from the current API surface to the new one with minimal disruption.
  • Work in the existing Ruby codebase where needed while the platform moves to the new architecture.
  • Contribute to API design, versioning and contracts so consumers can adopt new endpoints cleanly.
  • Support data synchronization work through delivery, helping get it across the finish line.
  • Write well-tested, observable, production-ready code and set the bar for code quality through reviews.

  • Partner closely with client engineering leads and the wider Transcenda team.

     

Must have

  • 8+ years of backend engineering experience building services and APIs in production, ideally 2+ years in a tech lead role.
  • Hands-on commercial experience with Rust, including async services (for example Tokio, Axum or Actix).
  • Working knowledge of Ruby, enough to read, maintain and safely change an existing Ruby codebase (using code assistants).
  • Strong API design skills: REST and/or gRPC, versioning, backward compatibility and client migration.
  • Solid grounding in relational databases, SQL and service-to-service integration.
  • Experience with testing, CI/CD and observability for backend services.
  • Proven ability to ramp up quickly on unfamiliar codebases and languages, and to bring a team along with you.
  • Experience driving agentic coding practices across a team: setting guidelines, defining review standards for AI-generated code, and helping engineers use these tools effectively and safely.

  • Clear written and spoken English and comfort working directly with client engineering leads.

     

Nice to have

  • C# / .NET experience, particularly on API clients or services.
  • Prior work on API platform migrations or strangler-pattern rewrites.
  • Exposure to metadata management or data synchronization systems.
  • Data engineering or ETL experience.
  • Background in regulated industries.

item.title: Rust Developer
item.description:
The role is based in the Kyiv region, and we will expect you to work full-time in the office. We have a shuttle service from the nearest metro station.

 

About the Job

We are seeking a skilled Core Developer (Rust/ C++) for Swarm Robotics & Sensor Control with over 5 years of professional experience to join our dynamic development team. You will play a key role in building and optimizing the core architectures for the real-time control and management of robotic swarms and sensor systems. This position offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and contribute to complex, mission-critical systems in a collaborative environment.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust and scalable systems for swarm control and sensor management.
  • Implement efficient communication protocols and real-time processing solutions for robotics.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to integrate backend components with robotics software and sensor networks.
  • Optimize system performance, scalability, and reliability in a distributed robotics environment.
  • Solve challenging problems using modern programming languages such as C++ and Rust.
  • Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and software design decisions.

What you bring to the team:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in backend development with a strong focus on real-time systems.
  • Proficiency in Rust and C++, with a solid understanding of modern software development practices.
  • Experience in building and optimizing backend architectures for distributed systems.
  • Familiarity with network protocols, multithreading, and low-latency data processing.
  • Knowledge of system architecture design, performance optimization, and resource management.

  • Ability to work independently, solve complex technical problems, and thrive in a fast-paced startup environment.

     

Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience in robotics, swarm control, or sensor integration.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms, Docker, or Kubernetes for scalable deployments.

  • Understanding of embedded systems or real-time operating environments.

     

Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We Stand with Ukraine
  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.
  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.
  • We push limits, think outside the box, and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.
  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.

item.title: Rust Developer
item.description:
At ZentixSoft, we are currently expanding our outstaffing operations for a key US-based fintech project and looking for a strong Senior Rust Backend Engineer with direct EVM blockchain integration experience.
 

Below are the core details and parameters of the request:

📋 Request Snapshot:

  • Role: Senior Rust Backend Engineer (Fintech / Blockchain / EVM).
  • Format: Full-time outstaff engagement, 100% Remote (EU-based).
  • Start Date: ASAP.
  • Schedule: Flexible with required partial overlap with US PST hours.
  • Project Scope: US early-stage fintech platform combining on-chain transactions with traditional banking/payment flows. High level of autonomy, zero micromanagement, and full ownership over production services.
     

🎯 Key Requirements (Must-Have):

  1. Rust Production Experience: 7+ years in commercial software engineering with 2–3+ years of active Rust in production.
  2. EVM / Blockchain Integration (Critical): Direct hands-on experience building backend systems interacting with Ethereum / EVM chains (RPC, event indexing, transaction lifecycle, key signing, chain reorganizations).
  3. Database & Financial Logic: Strong PostgreSQL (audit trails, transaction integrity) and experience in precision-critical systems (payments, ledgers, lending).
  4. Communication: Fluent written/verbal English for direct technical discussion and architectural reasoning.

item.title: Senior Rust Backend Engineer

item.title: Senior Stellar / Soroban / Rust Engineer /Blockchain
item.description:
Location: Remote / Worldwide
Engagement: Full-time / Part-time (negotiable)
Duration: Long-term / Project-based
English: Upper-Intermediate (B2+)
Rate: Negotiable, based on experience

 

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior/Lead Blockchain Engineer with strong expertise in Rust, Stellar, and Soroban to join an exciting blockchain project.

The initial engagement will involve a technical discussion with the client to evaluate project requirements, architecture, and potential implementation approaches.

There is an opportunity to transition into a long-term development or technical leadership role.

 

Requirements

  • Senior/Lead-level experience in Rust development.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Stellar and Soroban.
  • Commercial experience with Stellar/Soroban, ideally across 1–2 production or client projects.
  • Experience developing and integrating smart contracts.
  • Solid understanding of blockchain architecture, distributed systems, and security principles.
  • Ability to design technical solutions and evaluate implementation complexity.
  • Experience communicating directly with clients and discussing technical architecture.
  • English proficiency at B2 level or higher.

 

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Ethereum/EVM and Solidity.
  • Strong knowledge of Async Rust.
  • Experience with RPC, blockchain event indexing, and transaction signing.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and backend development.
  • Knowledge of Docker and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Previous experience in technical leadership or blockchain consulting.

 

Responsibilities

  • Participate in technical discussions with the client.
  • Analyze project requirements and assess technical feasibility.
  • Provide expertise in Stellar, Soroban, and smart contract architecture.
  • Propose scalable and secure technical solutions.
  • Estimate development efforts, timelines, and potential risks.
  • Potentially contribute to hands-on development and technical leadership as the project progresses.

 

Interview Process

  1. Initial screening and experience review.
  2. Technical discussion with the client.
  3. Discussion of engagement terms and next steps.

Important

 

We are specifically looking for engineers with real commercial experience in Stellar/Soroban development.

Candidates whose experience is limited to personal, experimental, or internal pet projects without commercial application may not be a fit for this opportunity.

How to Apply

 

Please share your CV along with:

  • A brief description of your Stellar/Soroban projects.
  • Your specific responsibilities and contributions.
  • Whether the projects were commercial or personal.
  • Your availability and expected hourly rate.

item.title: Software Engineer for the Networking Stream (IRC305579)
item.description:
Job Description:
 

  • Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field plus heavy experience in low-level network programming.
  • Mastery of Rust (for DPDK tre_flow), and Go for high-performance networking software.
  • Solid understanding of Linux network stack internals, socket layers, and packet processing.

  • Network feature development.

     

    Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience porting custom network daemons (Goblin, Comet) to new CPU architectures.

     

Job Responsibilities:
 

  • Port internal networking daemons and tools (Goblin, Comet, golinject) to run natively on ARM64 host environments.
  • Local Environment & Stack Setup: Stand up and maintain a local development environment running the entire Akamai Compute (Linode) stack (e.g., running on a single VM owned by the developer).
  • Debugging & ARM Porting: Proactively identify and debug complex issues across the software stack (including VMs, VM disks, and networking), and port existing software stack components to the ARM architecture.
  • Network Feature Development: Develop and enhance networking capabilities, including adding support for protocols (such as DHCPv6) into networking daemons and offloading network stack processing into NICs.
  • Performance & Profiling: Conduct performance tuning and packet-throughput profiling on high-speed network interfaces.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Proactively flag identified issues and collaborate with other engineering teams to drive resolutions.
     

Department/Project Description:

Seeking a Mid-Level Software Engineer to join the Platform Networking Team. The team builds low-level networking software, driver integrations, and custom daemons powering our data center network fabric. You will port network daemons and enable next-generation SmartNIC and NIC hardware support on our new ARM server fleet.

item.title: Rust Engineer
item.description:
Job Description

- Bachelor’s and/or master’s degree in computer science or equivalent

- 2+ years in software development, architecture, API design and Linux systems programming

- Strong experience in Rust

- Excellent modern C++ programming skills

- Strong experience with embedded build systems

- Experience in designing, implementing, and operating complex build systems in both monolithic and multi-repository environments.

- Experience in embedded systems engineering and embedded build tooling, including Open Embedded, BitBake, Bazel, Make, and CMake.

- Strong communicator, describing issues and solutions to various audiences

- Strong verbal and written communication skills in English

- Bonus points for any background with SmartTV technology

Job Responsibilities

- Design, implement, and operate complex build systems across monolithic and multi-repository environments, spanning both Bazel and BitBake/OpenEmbedded build paths.

- Build systems that bring together all components of a software product and enable it to function on the low-powered hardware found in embedded systems.

- Provide embedded software architecture input to ensure released products work efficiently within storage, memory, and processing constraints.

- Operate the build system in partnership with all software development teams, delivering feature enhancements and bug fixes for engineers who depend on it.

- Interpret build system output to understand both the system itself and the development goals of the teams it supports, ensuring timely and accurate support.

Department/Project Description

We're looking for Software Engineer to help design, implement, and operate the build systems that bring together every component of Client's embedded software products — set-top boxes, televisions, and soundbar speakers — and get them running on resource-constrained hardware. You'll partner with software development teams across the company, shipping feature enhancements and bug fixes within the build system, and interpreting build output to keep every team unblocked.
